instanceExperimentalSettings.talkToEachAgentIn: Talk to each agent in one ongoing conversation. Clarify goals and create tasks for execution. Chat leads the Work group and opens an agent rail beside the nav, and each chat's side panel shows the agent's tasks and artifacts as cards.

instanceExperimentalSettings.showPaperclipmanagedBuiltinAgentSurfaces: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.

instanceExperimentalSettings.connectAgentsToSlackDiscord: Connect agents to Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.

instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleCombinedInboxAndTask: Toggle combined inbox and task list experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.addsAConferenceRoomOne: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleConferenceRoomChatExperimental: Toggle conference room chat experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.showTheDecisionsItemIn: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.
instanceExperimentalSettings.showEnvironmentManagementInCompany: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.
instanceExperimentalSettings.detectExternalUrlsInIssues: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.
instanceExperimentalSettings.showExecutionWorkspaceControlsIn: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.
instanceExperimentalSettings.showConnectionsInCompanySettings: Show Connections in company settings and allow short acknowledgements while agents begin work.
instanceExperimentalSettings.firstTaskProposeWithA: First task: propose with a plan document

instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleFirstTaskPlanProposal: Toggle first task plan proposal experimental setting

instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleGithubReviewBotsExperimental: Toggle GitHub review bots experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.connectAnExistingGrokBot: Connect an existing Grok Bot as an agent. Verify routine delivery and an authenticated reply before assigning work.
instanceExperimentalSettings.connectMem0ZepSupermemoryCognee: Connect Mem0, Zep, Supermemory, Cognee, and Honcho for long-term memory and context.

Onboarding continues to use legacy adapters. Turning this off hides the choice without affecting existing native runs.
instanceExperimentalSettings.instructAgentsToWriteUser: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.
instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleSimplifiedEnglishInteractionsExper: Toggle simplified english interactions experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.enableTheExperimentalSharedStatuscard: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
instanceExperimentalSettings.useTheSimplifiedMainSidebar: Use the simplified main sidebar, shared Tasks and Inbox presentation, focused task detail layout, and contextual navigation across Agents, Routines, Skills, and Settings.
instanceExperimentalSettings.showSummarizergeneratedStatusSlotsOn: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
instanceExperimentalSettings.treatAProjectThatHas: Treat a project that has no execution workspace policy of its own as if it selected isolated workspaces, so its tasks get a per-task worktree instead of sharing the project checkout. A project that carries its own policy keeps it.
instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleIsolatedWorkspacesByDefault: Toggle isolated workspaces by default experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.internalToolsForDevelopingTesting: Internal tools for developing, testing, and debugging Paperclip.

instanceExperimentalSettings.hideTheLocalEnvironmentAnd: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.
instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleManagedEnvironmentOnlyExperimental: Toggle managed environment only experimental setting

instanceExperimentalSettings.togglePaperclipDeveloperModeExperimental: Toggle Paperclip developer mode experimental setting

instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleItOffAndBack: Toggle it off and back on to arm execution for tasks created here.
instanceExperimentalSettings.showAServerSectionIn: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.
instanceExperimentalSettings.toggleServerInfoDebugView: Toggle server info debug view experimental setting
instanceExperimentalSettings.addASmokeLabTab: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.
